query: For my 49‑year‑old female patient: among women aged 44–54, what is the minimum heart rate recorded within first 24 hours?
final_sql:
SELECT MIN(ce.valuenum) AS min_heart_rate
FROM `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.icustays` icu ON p.subject_id = icu.subject_id
JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.chartevents` ce ON icu.stay_id = ce.stay_id
JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.d_items` di ON ce.itemid = di.itemid
WHERE p.gender = 'F'
  AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 44 AND 54
  AND di.label = 'Heart Rate'
  AND ce.charttime >= icu.intime
  AND ce.charttime <= icu.intime + INTERVAL 24 HOUR
  AND ce.valuenum IS NOT NULL;
